module: Auxiliary reverse beep controller. Every 0.5 s, it tests an electric (default "reverse"): if it is > 0, it starts a looping beep sound; otherwise it stops it.
notes: jbeam keys read: electricsName ("reverse"), beepLoopName ("event:>Vehicle>Electrics>Reverse>Beep_01"), beepVolume (1), soundNode_nodes (first element = node, 0 otherwise).
The sound source is created on first activation (obj:createSFXSource2, AudioDefaultLoop3D); the test only happens every 0.5 s so the reaction can be delayed by up to 0.5 s.
reset does not cut the sound: isWarning is reset to false but the already started loop is not stopped.

reset.desc: Resets the state and the timer to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: starts or stops the beep depending on the electric.
